name: Higuera de la Serena (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Higuera de la Serena (a fig leaf, a tower and a sun on blue and red).
history: Municipal flag of Higuera de la Serena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Higuera de la Serena arms — fig leaf, tower and sun
